name: @kitora/terminal
description: Kitora's developer views: a terminal emulator view (ANSI colours, cursor, scrollback, input with history, pluggable session adapter), a virtualised log viewer (levels, filter, search, follow tail, JSON expansion), a split and unified diff viewer with word-level highlighting, and a JSON / YAML tree diff, on a framework-free core that stays fast at 100k lines.

exports.name: LogLineLayout
exports.description:
Row layout in whole LINES. Every row is 1+ lines tall (a wrapped message or an expanded JSON
detail adds lines), so the virtual list scrolls over line slots at a fixed line height and maps a
slot back to its row by binary search over the prefix table. This is the "measured row with an
offset table" approach, but heights are COMPUTED (line counts), never measured from the DOM, so
a 100k-row layout is one O(n) pass and a lookup is O(log n). With no row taller than one line the
table is skipped entirely (`offsets` is undefined and slot === row).
